```{r setup}
pkg_root <- params$pkg_path

if (!is.null(pkg_root) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "R"))) {
  devtools::load_all(pkg_root)
} else {
  library(ReportR)
}

spec_path <- if (!is.null(params$spec_file) && file.exists(params$spec_file)) {
  params$spec_file
} else if (!is.null(pkg_root) && !is.null(params$spec_file)) {
  file.path(pkg_root, params$spec_file)
} else {
  NULL
}
if (!is.null(spec_path)) source(spec_path)

enrollment_results <- readRDS(params$results_file)
min_n              <- params$min_n
```

## Key Enrollment Figures

```{r key-figures}
if (!is.null(enrollment_results$counts$by_year) &&
    nrow(enrollment_results$counts$by_year) > 0) {
  plot_enrollment_table(
    enrollment_results$counts$by_year,
    type = "counts",
    assessment_spec = assessment_spec

} else {
  cat("*Enrollment data not available.*\n")
}
```

## Notable Year-Over-Year Shifts

```{r notable-shifts, results='asis'}
# Identify the subgroup with the largest absolute proportion shift
transitions  <- enrollment_results$transitions
notable_sg   <- NULL
max_abs_chng <- 0

for (sg in names(transitions)) {
  smry <- transitions[[sg]]$summary
  if (!is.null(smry) && nrow(smry) > 0 && "pct_change" %in% names(smry)) {
    max_chng <- max(abs(smry[["pct_change"]]), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(max_chng) && max_chng > max_abs_chng) {
      max_abs_chng <- max_chng
      notable_sg   <- sg
    }
  }
}

if (!is.null(notable_sg)) {
  smry <- transitions[[notable_sg]]$summary
  # Show top 3 shifts by absolute magnitude
  top3 <- smry[order(abs(smry[["pct_change"]]), decreasing = TRUE), ]
  top3 <- top3[!is.na(top3[["pct_change"]]), ]
  top3 <- head(top3, 3)

  cat("The largest year-over-year shifts in subgroup composition occurred in",
      paste0("**", notable_sg, "**"), "(top changes shown below).\n\n")

  print(
    plot_enrollment_table(top3, type = "proportions",
                          assessment_spec = assessment_spec)
  )
} else {
  cat("*No notable shifts detected across subgroup composition indicators.*\n")
}
```

## Enrollment Composition

```{r sankey-primary, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Display Sankey diagram for the most policy-relevant categorical subgroup.
# Priority order: RACE_ETHNICITY, EL, FRL, IEP; fallback to first available.
priority_order <- c("RACE_ETHNICITY", "EL", "FRL", "IEP")
plot_sg <- NULL
for (sg in priority_order) {
  if (sg %in% names(enrollment_results$transitions)) {
    tbl <- enrollment_results$transitions[[sg]]$table
    if (!is.null(tbl) && nrow(tbl) > 0) {
      plot_sg <- sg
      break
    }
  }
}
if (is.null(plot_sg) && length(names(enrollment_results$transitions)) > 0) {
  plot_sg <- names(enrollment_results$transitions)[1]
}

if (!is.null(plot_sg) && requireNamespace("ggalluvial", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tbl <- enrollment_results$transitions[[plot_sg]]$table
  if (!is.null(tbl) && nrow(tbl) > 0) {
    plot_enrollment_sankey(
      tbl, subgroup_var = plot_sg,
      assessment_spec = assessment_spec
    )
  }
} else if (!requireNamespace("ggalluvial", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("*Install the `ggalluvial` package to render the composition diagram.*\n")
} else {
  cat("*No subgroup composition data available.*\n")
}
```
